mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above its 5-year moving average fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 480000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets drive wage inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) indicates a healthy labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above its 3-month moving average fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals potential Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST) combined with robust GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a healthy economy, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST > 1100 and GDPC1 > 17200) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In an overheating supply regime (INDPRO > 105), strong industrial activity leads to inflationary pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.
